'''Durace''' was a toxic, barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a hostile region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Although the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was breathable, Durace's hostile weather made colonization difficult.

==History==
When first discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Galaaron]]'' during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Durace was a pleasant world.

During the [[Galactic War]], a pharmaceutical [[Company/Legends|company]] hired individuals to retrieve some of Duraces extremely rare and widely banned [[Flower/Legends|flowers]], which could be dried and ingested for medicinal purposes.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|An Unusual Bloom}}</ref>

At some point, a large-scale disaster ruined the planet.
